title: Serwis o podatkach - Formularze - Podatki.gov.pl
content:
Source: MF podatki.gov.pl - PIT CIT i rozliczenia
URL: https://www.podatki.gov.pl/podatki-firmowe/cit/formularze/
- The page is a centralized portal for tax forms on podatki.gov.pl, specifically the “Serwis o podatkach – Formularze” section.
- It organizes tax topics into: Podatki osobiste (personal taxes), Podatki dla przedsiębiorców (taxes for entrepreneurs), Cło (customs), Poradniki i informatory (guides and manuals), Aktualności (news), Narzędzia (tools), and Załatw sprawę online (handle a matter online).
- Within taxes for entrepreneurs, it lists foundational corporate taxes and related categories, including:
- Podstawowe podatki dla przedsiębiorców (basic business taxes)
- Pozostałe podatki (other taxes) such as PCC, SD, mineral royalties, financial institutions, and excise-like cases
- Specific regimes and compliance terms: VAT-related topics, with references to withholding tax (WHT), MDR (tax schemes reporting), ICAP, ETACA, SME procedures, GLOBE, CRBR, etc.
- Other forma...
